如果计划观察他们（假定他们在我们的掌控范围内），我们需要在他们星球轨道上建立一座观测站。

texts.en:
We have detected a Pre-FTL society! Although they lack the kind of technology that allows us to traverse the stars, there is still a lot to be gained from these aliens. Whether it be learning from their culture or claiming them as slaves is up to us.

If we wish to observe them - assuming they are within our borders - we need to build an Observation Post around their world.

If we wish to invade, all we need do is muster our troops; they wouldn't stand much of a chance.
